build: version 1.0, eight D64 images (archive.org d64_Pool_of_Radiance_v1.0_1988_SSI_Disk_1_of_4_Side_A); BOOT prints "POOL OF RADIANCE, VERSION 1.0"

comments.text: FINAL's entry, from the linker, when the party has struck down the dragon in the last battle: the ending's two scenes. Sprites off, the sprites set up (setup_sprites), the pictures loaded and copied out of the way (load_scenes), the first scene (scene_dragon) and the second (scene_spirit). Then the picture window cleared, slot 3 emptied ($6E16 = $FF) and DUNGEON next ($6E11 = 1), whose script goes on after the fight.

Sprites 1 to 5 multicolour, in medium grey with dark grey and white as the shared colours, sprite 0 yellow; none doubled in size, all in front of the picture. The six sprites placed by sprite_x and sprite_y, and their pointers ($CFF8-$CFFD) set to images $20-$25, at $C800-$C97F.
The six sprites' places across, sprite 0 first: 80, 68, 92, 54, 107, 80.
Their places down: 75, 72, 72, 71, 71, 93.
Their images: $20 to $25.
Copies A (low) and X (high) bytes from ($A7) to ($A9), with all of RAM switched in (all_ram) and back out.

Copy Y of the six in the tables below (copy_from_lo to copy_count_hi) through copy_block: 0, $2C0 bytes from $8C00 (PIC $3A) to $C800, the sprites' images; 1, $600 bytes from $6500 to $D208, a SECSET's glyphs into the character set from character 65; 2, $600 from $6500 to $1600; 3, $600 from $1600 to $D200; 4 and 5, $600 from $8C00 to $1C00 and to $2200, two pictures kept for the second scene.
Each copy's source, low bytes: all 0.
Each copy's destination, low bytes.
Each copy's length, low bytes.
Each copy's source, high bytes: $8C, $65, $65, $16, $8C, $8C.
Each copy's destination, high bytes: $C8, $D2, $16, $D2, $1C, $22.
Each copy's length, high bytes: 2, then 6 for the rest.

The picture window set (picture_window) and cleared. Once ($0D61): PIC $3A into slot 5 and its sprites copied to $C800 (copy 0); SECSET07 into slot 3 and kept at $1600 (copy 2); SECSET08 into slot 3, left there; PIC $35 into slot 5, kept at $1C00 (copy 4); PIC $36, kept at $2200 (copy 5); PIC $34 into slot 5, left there; and SPELLE20 into slot 7 at $A700, whose two blocks of 15 by 15 characters and colours are the scenes' backgrounds.

The first scene. SECSET08's glyphs into the character set from character 65 (copy 1), with character 64 ($D200) solid. The background drawn from $A700 (draw_scene); ANIMATE given PIC $34 at $8C00 for the window at $CCCB, row 5, column 3 (set_place_entry, set_picture_entry). In the lower window, MORTALLY WOUNDED, THE DRAGON ROARS!, THE SPIRIT OF TYRANTHRAXUS FLARES UP and FROM THE DRAGON'S BODY.; sound 4 (play_sound). Then 140 frames of the picture's animation, and 80 frames in, when the count is 60, the window says "FOOLS, YOU HAVE BUT SLAIN THE BODY and I POSSESSED. I CANNOT BE DEFEATED!".
Not an entry: ECL64's code left in the snapshot at $9A9A calls $0969, COMBAT's status_window, here inside the JSR before it.
Not an entry: ECL64's code left in the snapshot at $9A97 calls $097A, COMBAT's show_panel.
The animation's frames, counted down in $0D5F from 140; the second speech when the count is 60.
Draws a background of 15 by 15 characters at rows 1 to 15, columns 1 to 15: the characters from A (low) and X (high), each one's colour from the 225 bytes after them.

The second scene. The picture window cleared; SECSET07's glyphs (kept at $1600) into the character set (copy 3); the background from $A8C2 (draw_scene); ANIMATE given the picture kept at $2200 (PIC $36) for the window at $CC2B, row 1, column 3; sprites 0 to 5 on. The spirit speaks: "WITH THE POWER OF POOL OF RADIANCE, WHICH I MOVED HERE, TO MY LAIR, I WILL STILL RULE, BY POSSESSING ONE OF YOU!". The colours flash (flash_spirit), sound $0A, and "NO LORD BANE! I CAN STILL RULE HERE! I HAVE NOT FAILED. DO NOT CALL ME BACK THROUGH THE POOL!". A head drawn over the picture (show_head), the sprites fade (fade_sprites), a pause, NOOOO ..., and sprite 0 falls (sprite_falls).
Sets the text window to the picture's square, columns 1 to 16 and rows 1 to 16 (the edges at $0A93).
picture_window's edges: left 1, right 16, top 1, bottom 16.

28 rounds of four animation frames, the picture's multicolour ($D022) and the sprites' second shared colour ($D026) going through light grey, grey, light grey and white (flash_colours), the sprites' images swapped each round (swap_images).
The flashing colours, read from the last: white, light grey, grey, light grey.

ANIMATE told to draw a head (picture_kind = 1) from $1C00, the picture kept from PIC $35, at $CC2B ($FD/$FE, set_place_entry with A = 1), its shown header forgotten ($86B7 = $FF) so that it draws afresh. Five frames, with a wait after each.
Five steps, each followed by a wait: sprites 1 to 5 and their two shared colours step down from the fade tables (fade_colour, fade_shared1, fade_shared2) to black.
Read at fade_colour plus 1 to 5, so the RTS here is never read: sprites 1-5's colour for each step, from the last: medium grey, medium grey, medium grey, dark grey, black.
Read one byte on, likewise: the first shared colour ($D025), from the last: dark grey four times, then black.
Read one byte on: the second shared colour ($D026), from the last: light grey, light grey, medium grey, dark grey, black.
Sprite 0 moves down two lines a step, the wait between steps shorter each time (from 100 down by 4), and turns red once the wait is under 50. Then all sprites off and a pause.
Switches sprites 1 to 5 ($CFF9-$CFFD) between images $21-$25 and $26-$2A (image_sets), $0D62 telling which.
The two sets of images for sprites 1 to 5: $21-$25, three unused bytes, then $26-$2A.
Prints FINAL's message X at the start of the next row.
Prints message X at the start of the cursor's row, in the window's text colour ($6E34): its address from say_lo and say_hi.

FINAL's 14 messages, zero-terminated; messages 0 and 1 are both the first: MORTALLY WOUNDED, THE DRAGON ROARS!, THE SPIRIT OF TYRANTHRAXUS FLARES UP, FROM THE DRAGON'S BODY., "FOOLS, YOU HAVE BUT SLAIN THE BODY, I POSSESSED. I CANNOT BE DEFEATED!", "WITH THE POWER OF POOL OF RADIANCE, WHICH I MOVED HERE, TO MY LAIR, I WILL STILL RULE, BY POSSESSING ONE, OF YOU!", "NO LORD BANE! I CAN STILL RULE HERE!, I HAVE NOT FAILED. DO NOT CALL ME BACK, THROUGH THE POOL!", NOOOO ....
Not an entry: print_line_here in COMBAT3 ($7AAC) reads the adventure module's table at $0CAD, here inside message 8.
Not an entry: print_line_here ($7AB1) reads the adventure module's high-byte table at $0CD5, here inside message 10.
Not an entry: ECL64's code left in the snapshot at $9AA3 calls $0CFE, COMBAT's apply_damage, here inside message 11.
Not an entry: SECSET64's code left in the snapshot at $6709 and $670C refers to $0D0D, here inside message 11.
The 14 messages' addresses, low bytes.
The 14 messages' addresses, high bytes, $0B to $0D.
Starts sound A (sound_start_entry). The $BD48 it first writes to $B8/$B9 does not last: sound_start brings in the driver's own zero page from $BA08, whose base is $BD7B.
A count: the first scene's frames, flash rounds, show_head's frames, fade steps, sprite_falls' wait.
flash_spirit's colour, 3 down to 0.
1 once load_scenes has loaded and copied the pictures.
Which of image_sets sprites 1 to 5 show, 0 or 1.
